description: Merges eight gate streams, and a polyphonic cable, into one gate stream

inputs.text: One of the gates being merged, counted as true at 1V or more
Every channel of the cable patched here is merged along with the numbered inputs

outputs.text: 10V while any input is true, 0V when none is
10V only while every input is false
A 1ms trigger each time any input rises
